feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: NPR coverage of national news, U.S. politics, elections, business, arts, culture, health and science, and technology. Subscribe to the NPR Nation RSS feed.

entry.title: REMEMBERING LOVED ONES KILLED IN UNITED 93 CRASH
entry.summary: On September 11, 2001 Lori Guadagno lost her brother on flight United 93. 25 years later, the crash site is a place where she feels a sense of connection that she can't find anywhere else.

entry.title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court deports legal US resident to Afghanistan in first-ever case
entry.summary: Nazira Haji Zada, a lawful permanent resident, conceded to being an "alien terrorist." It marks the first case in the Alien Terrorist Removal Court.

entry.title: Manhattan's Trinity Church unveils new pipe organ, replacing one damaged in 9/11 attacks
entry.summary: Manhattan's Trinity Church marked the 25th anniversary of 9/11 with a concert featuring a new cathedral-sized pipe organ, replacing the hundred-year-old instrument damaged in the attacks.

entry.title: Trump meets Ireland's leaders before heading to his golf club in Doonbeg
entry.summary: President Trump held talks in Dublin with Irish President Catherine Connolly and Ireland's Prime Minister Micheál Martin during a weekend visit centered on a major golf tournament.

entry.title: Miami crash raises concerns about the jet's operator, and why it's flying for Amazon
entry.summary: The cargo plane crash in Miami is raising concerns about the safety culture at 21 Air, one of the carriers that fly for Amazon. Former pilots were sounding alarms even before Sunday's accident.

entry.title: Neighbor turned on neighbor after Charlie Kirk's killing. Is the divide here to stay?
entry.summary: The assassination of far right activist Charlie Kirk opened the floodgates of neighbor-on-neighbor doxing. A year later, the damage to political discourse in the U.S. remains.

entry.title: 25 years since 9/11, remembrances and a pledge to never forget
entry.summary: Events to honor the nearly 3,000 who perished on 9/11 and more are underway Friday, including in New York City.

entry.title: In photos: Remembering the Sept. 11 attacks, 25 years later
entry.summary: Around the U.S., ceremonies commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11th terror attacks in New York and at the Pentagon.

entry.title: As diseases loom, CDC's response to measles deaths stirs fears about agency's reliability
entry.summary: The worst U.S. measles outbreak in decades is growing and flu season is imminent. Experts are fretting about federal health data reliability after the CDC questioned two Pennsylvania measles deaths.

entry.title: The voices of Sept. 11: 'My first thought was ... I can't believe that I survived'
entry.summary: We listen back to interviews recorded in the aftermath of Sept. 11, with a particular focus on stories of survival and loss at the World Trade Center, and some reflections in poetry and music.
